title: Code and PR Review
rule: Before reviewing any PR or diff, read docs/design/project-design.md first and extract every numbered guideline (G1, G2, ...). Check the diff against every guideline and include a project design conformance table in the review output. This check works in a fresh session with no code context — the project design and the diff are sufficient.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review a PR, branch, diff, or working-tree changes; loads project design guidelines first and works in a fresh session
commands.prompt:
Use the `review-pr` skill.

First, read docs/design/project-design.md if it exists and extract every numbered guideline (G1, G2, ...). Also read any feature design or plan document relevant to the target change (docs/plans/, docs/design/). This is the architectural source of truth.

Then obtain the diff for the target below. Evaluate the diff against every project guideline and against the standard review checklist. Write a structured review that begins with a project design conformance table (one row per guideline: id, one-line rule, ✅/❌/— status, evidence from the diff), followed by severity-ranked findings.

If the full codebase is not available (architecture-first mode), say so explicitly and note which checks were skipped (full-file context, callers/callees, test execution).

Target: $ARGUMENTS
